unit.what: AgentViz Node tests, including parser, discovery, view, host message and host runner regressions. This does not prove browser or VS Code GUI acceptance; see host and browser.

syntax.what: Syntax checks for the production JavaScript files named by the existing script.

host.what: Starts a fresh VS Code development host on native Windows with a new temporary profile and synthetic source folders, drives the real webview, and fails on a missing, failed or incomplete result. Opens a VS Code window for about 40 seconds. Needs VS Code installed (or AGENTVIZ_VSCODE). Receipt: artifacts/host/extension-host-result.json. Does not cover Linux, VSCodium or a live AgentBoard caller.

browser.what: Inspects the emitted UI in headless Edge or Chrome with real key presses at 1280, 600 and 360 px: focus, accessible names, contrast, example and real labels, console and policy errors. Uses a temporary browser profile and synthetic data. Receipt and screenshots: artifacts/browser/. Does not cover VS Code theme colours or the real clipboard.

package.what: Build a local AgentViz VSIX using the locked development tool. Does not install, publish or push it. Inspect the archive separately.
